        alert2.update_progress(50, "50%")
        alert2.update_progress(100, "100%")

    except Exception as e:

    alert3 = sw.Alert()

        alert3.update_progress(75, "75 units")
        alert3.update_progress(150, "150 units")

    print("✅ tqdm integration allows flexible ranges") 
    print("✅ Backward compatibility maintained")
    print("✅ Integration with tqdm arguments preserved")

if __name__ == "__main__":
